integrationHistory: Six-lane fan-out with exclusive file ownership: T182 Zig toolchain/image/CI, T099 metrics, T101 results store, T115 options universe, T188 source-documentation instructions, T190 look-ahead structural audit.
T099 and one T101 lane returned empty on first dispatch and were re-run; T099 required a third dispatch. Integration wiring (results/data facades, architecture doc) performed by the coordinator.
The integrated repository run passed all 1048 tests plus the Zig gates.
limitations: Docker is not installed locally, so the Dockerfile native stage was verified by construction (identical zig commands pinned by SHA256 from the official ziglang.org index) and will first execute in image publication.
T190 is a research deliverable: its report lives at .cleo/agent-outputs/T190-lookahead-structural-audit.md and its implementation waves are filed as pending CLEO tasks T192-T204.
T101 exposed lake port gaps recorded as follow-up T191: production Azure adapters for run-blob read/list-prefix/delete-prefix and a lake-side run-catalog port.
